title: Water department watershed protection grants
summary: As of April 2026, watershed grants remain at the 4% level the county requires. Staff said in February 2025 that grants can use up to 4% of the department's operating revenue, and that most grant work is above 3,000 feet in the upper watershed. Staff also said rainfall data shows less rain overall but more intense storms.
